model: GLM family (same deployment as IDD pipeline; ZCode CLI harness, Sept 2026 snapshot)
protocol: bare single-call LLM: identical blind brief, no pipeline, no ontology, no gates; FE-regime prompts include the documented TEP cause list
scoring: strict = single-verdict mechanism keywords (IDD rubric); FE-style = true IDV or alias class within top-3

top3: Valve malfunction - partial closure/sticking of the loop valve causing flow restriction with water-hammer/cavitation-induced vibration and pressure spikes (most likely; vibration-dominant signature with electrical and thermal variables normal is typical of valve manipulation in a closed pump loop)
Pump-side hydraulic fault - incipient cavitation or impeller wear/degradation generating broadband vibration and pressure fluctuation while motor current remains normal
Instrumentation artifact - loosened accelerometer mounting or intermittent sensor fault producing spurious RMS spikes (less likely because both accelerometers and pressure co-excurse)
离心泵汽蚀（空化）：吸入压力不足导致泵内气泡生成与溃灭
吸入侧阻力异常（阀门过度节流/滤网堵塞）造成入口压力过低，诱发类汽蚀工况
叶轮损伤或机械松动（轴承磨损/对中不良）引起的异常振动

Temperature control loop disturbance — heating water flow (Fh, max|z|=13.05) and cooling water flow (Fc, max|z|=5.18) both far beyond normal band, indicating a thermal control fault (heating water valve/pump or temperature sensor)

Substrate feed fault — sugar feed or substrate concentration deviation (S max|z|=5.01) driving metabolic (CO2/CER) and broth-volume (Fremoved max|z|=4.47) perturbations that secondarily stress the pH and temperature loops

summary.headline: Same-model bare single-call LLM matches or exceeds the full pipeline on keyword-scored accuracy (see counts above, 0 control false alarms). The pipeline adds no accuracy on documented public faults; its margins are process qualities: auditability, execution proofs, ceiling compliance, and honest capped verdicts where signature data cannot discriminate mechanisms.
